author: Jerrypppp
quote:
The game is called Grand Theft Auto, yet stealing cars is apparently forbidden in the game. Female drivers are especially prone to panic attacks, so you have to stay away from them.
The protagonist is a mentally ill slut who cheats on you by hooking up with two men. You're still expected to bend over backwards to keep her happy, and breaking up is not allowed either. You have to be her emotional doormat, like some shameless, spineless bastard.
Even though Lucia has ghosted you for an entire decade, you're still not allowed to pursue relationships with other women. They even removed the escorts from strip clubs. Talk about a pathetic excuse for a dating simulator.
You must side with KAIHA and put up with the progressive, politically correct agenda, or the game will break (the Black women will get upset).
Attacking NPCs is prohibited, especially minorities (Black and Brown people).
The female characters in the game are deliberately designed to be ugly and obese.
The only condition under which you're allowed to cheat on Lucia is if you hook up with a fat guy.
This is officially the most sinister foidslop in gaming history.
